name: Kusanagi Kyou
source:
Country: Japan.
Heir of the Kusanagi clan, with the ability to manipulate fire. Kyo is a high school dropout, but his charisma knows know bounds. Despite his strict upbringing, he is a delinquent. Cocky, yet well meaning. He goes wherever his interests take him and doesn't care for responsibilities and obligations. He may seem arrogant, but he cares for his loved ones. Enjoys writing poetry. Favorite food is fried fish.
